name: OncoVI resource mapping
license: MIT for upstream scripts; external database licenses apply
intentional_differences: OP1 requires all available independent predictor groups to support oncogenicity; upstream OncoVI uses an OR condition.
OS2 and SBS2 are not inferred from germline ClinVar classification; functional evidence must be explicitly curated.
OVS1 does not treat stop-loss as a null variant.
SBVS1 and SBS1 are mutually exclusive to avoid double counting the same population evidence.
Missing evidence is reported as not_assessable, never as evidence against a criterion.
